DataSource.query:
begin
select c.COD_CUSTOMER,
case when c.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP in ('90','99') then  c.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP else 'Others' end as code_grpt,
case when c.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = '90' then '90 - clients KCS / CH'
     when c.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = '99' then '99 - Kuhn Group'
	 else 
	 'Others' end as lib_grpt,
c.LAB_CUSTOMER,
c.COD_RESIDENCE_COUNTRY
from common.DIM_CUSTOMER_COGNOS c left outer join accounting.FACT_SAVING_LEDGER s on c.SEQ_CUSTOMER_COGNOS = s.SEQ_INVOICE_CUSTOMER_COGNOS
left outer join common.DIM_DATE_VIEW d on s.SEQ_ENTRY_DAY = d.SEQ_DAY
where (year(d.[DATE]) >= 2010 or d.[DATE] is null) 
group by c.COD_CUSTOMER,
case when c.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP in ('90','99') then  c.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP else 'Others' end,
case when c.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = '90' then '90 - clients KCS / CH'
     when c.COD_CUSTOMER_GROUP = '99' then '99 - Kuhn Group'
	 else 
	 'Others' end,
c.LAB_CUSTOMER,
c.COD_RESIDENCE_COUNTRY
order by c.COD_CUSTOMER
end
